mo_ta_cong_viec:
Lead and execute test planning, test design, and execution for complex features and your assigned products/projects.
Take end-to-end ownership of quality in your assigned products/projects.
Identify, document, and track bugs with clear, actionable reports.
Use and champion AI-augmented testing (AI-assisted test generation, triage, coverage analysis) as part of your day-to-day work.
Contribute hands-on to automation and help strengthen the team's automation coverage.
Mentor peers and raise the testing bar across the team — make the people around you better, not just perform well on your own.
Proactively flag risks and propose solutions before they become problems.
Collaborate closely with developers, product analysts, project analysts, and stakeholders to drive quality outcomes.
Help improve QA processes, documentation, and best practices that others adopt.
yeu_cau:
5+ years of QA experience with strong hands-on testing skills (functional, regression, integration, API, DB, etc.).
AI competency (required). Comfortable applying AI tools to real testing work. This is a baseline expectation, not a plus.
Alignment with company core values (required). High autonomy, high ownership, and a bar-raising mindset.
Automation experience (Playwright, or similar) — hands-on and expected at this level.
Strong critical thinking and analytical skills — you catch what others miss.
Multiplier mindset — you make the team better and set standards others follow, not just deliver your own work.
Fully autonomous — you don't wait to be told; you identify gaps and act, with no hand-holding.
High sense of responsibility and ownership — you see things through, not just report them.
Advanced English — able to communicate fluently in writing and speech with cross-functional teams.
Collaborative spirit and good attitude — you lift the people around you.
